**Finding submitted: LOL-CAP — missing (fallback target).**

The Agreement contains no limitation of liability provision anywhere — I read the full body (Articles 1–10), including the Warranties article (p0055–p0058), the Confidentiality article (p0047–p0054) and all of General Provisions (p0059–p0070). The only occurrences of "liability" are the no-joint-venture disclaimers in Section 10.2, and there is no consequential-damages waiver, aggregate cap or exclusive-remedy language. Both parties are exposed without limit, which fails the fallback.

Cure: one insert of new Section 10.9 after Section 10.8, carrying exactly the six fallback elements — a mutual aggregate cap at fees paid or payable by the Company in the twelve months preceding the claim, with confidentiality obligations, indemnification obligations, gross negligence and willful misconduct uncapped. I deliberately did not import the preferred-level USD 1,000,000 floor, consequential-damages waiver, data protection/security, fraud or IP carve-outs, or the payment-obligations exclusion, since the fallback is an acceptable landing spot and the checklist is the ceiling as well as the floor.
